# get_sampling_paths_for_region { #mofography.compute.get_sampling_paths_for_region }

`compute.get_sampling_paths_for_region(region_index, connections, dgrid, regions, maxima, shape, ase_atoms)`

> It finds the paths from the maxima of a region to the windows of that region

## Parameters

| Name           | Type   | Description                                                                                           | Default    |
|----------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `region_index` |        | the index of the region you want to find the paths for                                                | _required_ |
| `connections`  |        | a list of tuples, each tuple contains the indices of the connected regions and the window coordinates | _required_ |
| `dgrid`        |        | the distance grid                                                                                     | _required_ |
| `maxima`       |        | the indices of the maxima of the region                                                               | _required_ |
| `shape`        |        | shape of the grid                                                                                     | _required_ |
| `ase_atoms`    |        | ASE atoms object                                                                                      | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                   |
|--------|-------------------------------|
|        | The paths are being returned. |
